prompt: Create an original 60 second Japanese acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: koto, shakuhachi, soft hand drum. Style: sparse plucked phrases and gentle breathy flute, no voice. Tempo approximately 60 BPM; D major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A serene and contemplative instrumental piece featuring a prominent plucked zither (likely guzheng) playing a gentle, flowing melody. It is accompanied by a soft string ensemble and a melodic flute, creating a peaceful and reflective atmosphere with a subtle melancholic undertone.
description.zh: 一首宁静而沉思的纯音乐作品，以突出的拨弦乐器（可能是古筝）演奏着轻柔流畅的旋律。伴随着柔和的弦乐合奏和悠扬的笛声，营造出平和、富有内省的氛围，并带有一丝淡淡的忧郁。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
